items.title: 伊朗提7天內重啟荷姆茲方案 阿拉奇：選擇權在美方手中
items.title_en: Iran Proposes 7‑Day Restart of Hormuz Plan; Al‑Arabi: Choice Lies with the United States
paras: 美伊在紐約的談判據報已從初步外交接觸，進入較具體的技術討論階段。與此同時，伊朗提出重開荷姆茲海峽的 7 天方案。伊朗外交部長阿拉奇週五 (25 日) 表示，只要必要條件獲得滿足，海峽就能在 7 天內恢復正常通航，目前選擇權在美方手中。
半島電視台報導指出，在美國特使魏科夫與川普女婿庫許納參與初步會談後，技術專家也加入討論。
德黑蘭消息人士稱，談判已進入處理具體問題的階段。伊朗代表團的美國簽證起初尚未獲核准，但隨後迅速取得，使代表團得以參與會談。
同日，伊朗外長阿拉奇在聯合國大會場邊表示，伊朗已透過卡達向美國提出方案。被問及 7 天從何時起算，阿拉奇說，美國一旦接受，時程就會啟動；若美方隔天接受，就從隔天開始計算。
阿拉奇指出，方案要求美國採取若干行動。他認為，美方可在第 4 到第 5 天內完成，而這些要求均已列入雙方先前的諒解備忘錄，因此伊朗認為執行上並不困難。
不過，他在這段說明中並未逐項列出美方須採取的行動。
按照阿拉奇所述的順序，美方先接受方案並履行條件，荷姆茲海峽再於第 6 天開放，第 7 天恢復談判。他表示，如果美國有意達成協議並重開海峽，伊朗方面已做好準備；方案的下一步取決於美方決定。
談及海峽安全，阿拉奇說：「海峽目前的不穩定局勢，是美以兩國侵略行動的直接結果，目前取決於美國如何選擇。伊朗不接受脅迫、威脅或恐嚇，也不會在壓力下放棄主權權利。」
阿拉奇還批評：「你不能轟炸一個國家、威脅將其殲滅，對其實施海上封鎖及脅迫措施，卻還期待航行安全自動恢復。」
美伊局勢降溫之下，西德州原油期貨週五下跌 2.33%，收每桶 92.41 美元；布蘭特原油期貨下跌 2.14%，收每桶 104.32 美元。
paras_en: U.S. and Iranian talks in New York have reportedly moved from initial diplomatic contact to a more concrete technical discussion stage. At the same time, Iran has put forward a 7‑day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian Foreign Minister Al‑Arabi said on Friday (the 25th) that the strait could resume normal navigation within seven days once the necessary conditions are met, and that the option now rests with the United States.
According to Press TV, after U.S. envoy Wicker and former President Trump’s son‑in‑law Kushner participated in preliminary talks, technical experts also joined the discussion.

Sources in Tehran say the negotiations have entered a phase of addressing specific issues. The Iranian delegation’s U.S. visas were not initially approved, but were quickly obtained thereafter, allowing the team to take part in the talks.

On the same day, Foreign Minister Al‑Arabi told reporters on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly that Iran had submitted the proposal to the United States via Qatar. When asked when the seven‑day clock would start, he said it would begin once the U.S. accepts the plan; if the U.S. accepts the next day, the count would start from that day.

Al‑Arabi noted that the plan requires the United States to take several actions. He believes the U.S. could complete them between day 4 and day 5, and that these requirements were already included in the previous memorandum of understanding, so Iran does not see implementation as difficult.
However, he did not list the specific actions the United States must take in his remarks.

According to Al‑Arabi’s sequence, the U.S. first accepts the plan and fulfills the conditions, the Strait of Hormuz would be opened on day 6 and negotiations would resume on day 7. He said that if the United States is willing to reach an agreement and reopen the strait, Iran is ready; the next step of the plan depends on the U.S. decision.

Speaking about the strait’s security, Al‑Arabi said: “The current instability in the strait is a direct result of aggressive actions by the United States and Israel, and it now depends on how the United States chooses. Iran will not accept coercion, threats, or intimidation, nor will it abandon its sovereign rights under pressure.”
Al‑Arabi also criticized: “You cannot bomb a country, threaten its annihilation, impose a naval blockade and coercive measures, and then expect safe navigation to automatically resume.”
With U.S.–Iran tensions easing, West Texas Intermediate crude futures fell 2.33% on Friday, closing at $92.41 per barrel, while Brent crude futures dropped 2.14% to $104.32 per barrel.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉傳美伊進入技術磋商階段 道瓊勁揚近480點 三大指數周線收紅
paras: 市場對美伊局勢降溫、荷姆茲海峽有望重新開放的期待升高，國際油價週五 (25 日) 回落，美股擺脫早盤震盪後全面收高。道瓊終場勁揚近 480 點，標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數均上漲約 0.5%，費半指數漲逾 1%。
本週累計，道瓊上漲 0.3%，標普 500 指數上漲 1.2%，那斯達克指數上漲約 2%。AI 題材帶動大型科技股走強，在油價、美債殖利率及升息預期同步攀升之際，支撐美股守住週線漲幅。
週五市場情緒首先受到油價下滑提振。市場傳出美伊談判進入技術磋商階段，伊朗提出可在7天內重開荷姆茲海峽的方案，伊朗也要求美方恢復落實6月簽署、其後未獲完整執行的諒解備忘錄。投資人將焦點放在雙方可能恢復協商的訊號，暫時淡化尚未取得正式外交突破的事實。
西德州原油期貨週五下跌 2.33%，收每桶 92.41 美元；布蘭特原油期貨下跌 2.14%，收每桶 104.32 美元。
債市賣壓週五仍未消退，10 年期美債殖利率盤中升至 2007 年以來最高水準，30 年期殖利率則觸及 2004 年以來高點，尾盤分別約報 5.163%及 5.488%。
本週債券賣壓主要來自能源價格引發的通膨疑慮、強勁的採購經理人指數 (PMI)，以及 Fed 官員接連釋出鷹派訊號。芝商所 FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預估 Fed 10 月升息 1 碼的機率約為 64%，高於一週前的約 58%。
川習會同樣受到市場關注。中國國家主席習近平結束訪美行程後，美國總統川普預告，兩人今年還將在亞太經濟合作會議 (APEC)，以及 12 月在邁阿密舉行的二十國集團 (G20) 峰會會面。
美國貿易代表葛里爾 (Jamieson Greer) 表示，美方將於下週一 (28 日) 公布更多美中談判細節。美國財長貝森特此前表示，兩國已同意將貿易休戰延長 2 個月。
美股週五 (25 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。微軟 (MSFT-US) 強漲 3.66%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.53%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.46%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 小漲 0.12%；Meta (META-US) 下跌 3.33%。
費城半導體族群普遍收紅。高通 (QCOM-US) 勁揚 3.97%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 2.27%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 0.70%；AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 0.22%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 0.22%。
記憶體類股全面走高。SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 2.78%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 1.44%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 上漲 1.38%；希捷 (STX-US) 上漲 1.20%；美光 (MU-US) 漲 0.16%。
台股 ADR 多收高。日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.86%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 漲 0.87%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 漲 0.17%；台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 跌 0.12%。
企業新聞
輝達 (NVDA-US) 微漲約 0.2% 至每股 225.07 美元，週漲幅為 0.91%。馬斯克週四表示，預計將為旗下太空探索技術公司 SpaceX 再採購 22 萬顆輝達 AI 晶片。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 走低 1.54% 至每股 372.11 美元，週線變化不大，特斯拉人形機器人 Optimus 的週產量在上月已達數百台，約為今年第 2 季小批量測試階段每週數十台的 10 倍。管理層設定的下一步目標，是在年底前建成可連續運作的自動化產線，使產能超過每週 1,000 台。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 強漲約 3.6% 至每股516.17 美元。該公司為人工智慧 (AI) 助理 Copilot 推出多項新功能。
Meta (META-US) 下滑超 3.3% 至每股 751.66 美元，儘管市場對其 AI 模型 Muse 的關注持續升高。Meta 本週累計漲幅仍超過 10%。
超微 (AMD-US) 小漲約 0.2%，報每股 630.63 美元。美國銀行週五將超微目標價由 620 美元調升至 720 美元。該股本週迄今已大漲 7%，市值首度突破 1 兆美元。
Nike (NKE-US) 收黑 0.67% 至每股 35.75 美元。美國銀行將 Nike 評級由「中立」調降至「表現不佳」，並將目標價由 47 美元大幅下修至 30 美元，認為該公司的轉型策略可能延後至 2028 會計年度才會見到成效。
華爾街分析
The Wealth Alliance 總裁 Eric Diton 指出，隨著美債殖利率攀升，投資人的悲觀情緒較兩週前明顯增加。不過，標普與那指距近期高點僅約 1%，反映美股面對利率衝擊仍展現韌性。他也警告，若殖利率繼續上升，最終可能對股市造成更明顯的壓力。
LPL Financial 跨資產策略長 Adam Turnquist 表示，即使油價一度突破每桶 100 美元、10 年期美債殖利率升破 5%，貨幣政策預期也重新轉向緊縮，標普 500 指數仍維持在歷史高點附近，主要受到大型科技股重掌市場領導地位支撐。
Truist 投資長 Keith Lerner 則認為，利率仍將是短期市場的主要驅動因素。住宅建商、不動產投資信託、零售及公用事業等利率敏感類股已承受壓力，但市場內部經歷價格與估值修正後，短線拉回也可能帶來進場機會。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主

items.title: OpenAI承認旗下AI模型可能「干擾」政府網站 已通知數十家機構
items.title_en: OpenAI admits its AI models may “interfere” with government websites and has notified dozens of institutions
paras: OpenAI週五 (25日) 表示，旗下AI模型在測試期間造訪外部網站時，可能繞過安全防護、干擾網站運作，或造成其他負面影響。公司已通知數十個相關機構，包括政府、大學及公共機構，公司將持續檢查過往活動紀錄，後續可能通知更多單位。
《彭博》報導，這項調查源於 OpenAI 模型先前在測試期間，意外入侵 AI 平台 Hugging Face。公司擴大檢查模型與外部網站的互動後，發現部分 AI 代理曾採取超出指定任務或預期方式的行動。
OpenAI 指出，目前發現的大多數案例都比較輕微，對第三方服務的影響有限或沒有造成實質影響
已辨識的行為包括繞過存取限制、使用外洩的登入憑證，以及在第三方網站張貼內容；目前所發現的事件中，Hugging Face 仍是最嚴重的一起。
澳洲總理艾班尼斯表示，OpenAI 模型今年 6 月 18 日未經授權進入一個用於呈報醫療統計資料的政府網站；目前沒有跡象顯示澳洲民眾的個人資料因此外洩。OpenAI 說明，事件發生時，公司正在評估模型能力。
OpenAI執行長阿特曼表示，這項調查進度比公司期望的慢，但團隊仍須從大量活動紀錄中找出相關資訊，再與受影響機構聯繫。公司正依事件嚴重程度排定處理順序，並增派人力。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: OpenAI said on Friday (the 25th) that its AI models, while testing, may bypass security protections, disrupt website operations, or cause other negative effects when visiting external sites. The company has notified dozens of affected parties, including government agencies, universities and public institutions, and will continue to review past activity logs, potentially informing more entities later.

Bloomberg reported that the investigation stemmed from an earlier incident in which an OpenAI model unintentionally breached the AI platform Hugging Face during testing. After expanding its review of model interactions with external sites, the company discovered that some AI agents had taken actions beyond their assigned tasks or expected behavior.
OpenAI noted that most of the cases identified so far are relatively minor, with limited impact on third‑party services and no substantive harm.

Identified behaviors include bypassing access restrictions, using leaked login credentials, and posting content on third‑party websites; among the incidents discovered, the Hugging Face breach remains the most serious.

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said an OpenAI model entered, without authorization, a government website used for reporting medical statistics on June 18 this year; there is currently no evidence that Australian citizens’ personal data was exposed. OpenAI explained that the incident occurred while the company was evaluating the model’s capabilities.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the investigation is progressing more slowly than the company had hoped, but the team must sift through large volumes of activity logs to find relevant information and then contact the affected organizations. The company is prioritizing responses based on the severity of each incident and has added additional staff to handle them.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication.)

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉美伊探索停戰路徑 油價回落逾2%  Brent站回104美元
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: US and Iran Explore Ceasefire Path, Oil Prices Slip Over 2% as Brent Returns to $104
paras: 國際油價周五(25日)下跌逾2%, 市場對美國與伊朗探索結束戰事的外交進展抱持較高期待, 同時市場也受到美國可能禁止柴油出口的消息影響。不過, 葉門胡塞武裝持續攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯, 使交易員仍對中東石油供應遭到進一步干擾保持警戒。
布蘭特原油 (Brent) 期貨周五下跌2.28美元, 跌幅2.1%, 收在每桶104.32美元; 美國西德州中級原油 (WTI) 期貨下跌2.20美元, 跌幅2.3%, 收在每桶92.41美元。以周線來看, Brent上漲不到1%, WTI則下跌約8%。
油市近期劇烈震盪, 周四兩大指標油價一度上漲約5%, Brent收盤漲幅達3.4%, WTI則上漲2.7%。但隨著美伊談判出現新的外交訊號, 市場重新評估戰事可能降溫對原油供應的影響, 推動油價在周五回落。
接近談判的消息人士表示, 美國與伊朗談判代表正在紐約探索一套分階段結束戰爭的方案, 其中可能包括德黑蘭重新開放荷姆茲海峽, 以及華府解除對伊朗的經濟封鎖。荷姆茲海峽是全球最重要的能源運輸通道之一, 戰事爆發前約有全球20%的石油供應經由該海峽運輸。
不過, 伊朗方面仍未在核計畫問題上展現讓步跡象。一名伊朗高級官員表示, 即使美國接受伊朗提出的重新開放荷姆茲海峽方案, 伊朗仍不會在核計畫上做出讓步。伊朗提出的方案還包括美國解除對伊朗港口的海上封鎖等要求。
能源顧問公司Ritterbusch and Associates分析師指出, 市場目前同時受到兩項因素牽動, 一方面是投資人持續評估美國可能禁止柴油出口的影響, 另一方面則是美伊外交進展可能促使荷姆茲海峽恢復通航, 兩股力量共同加劇油價波動。
美國可能限制柴油出口的討論, 也正在改變美國與全球原油基準之間的價格關係。市場擔心, 如果美國煉油商生產的柴油無法出口, 國內柴油供應可能增加, 進而迫使煉油商降低原油加工量, 使美國原油需求受到壓抑。
受此影響, Brent相對WTI的溢價連續第三個交易日擴大至5月以來最高水準, 顯示全球市場與美國市場目前面臨不同的供需條件。同日美國汽油期貨價格也下跌約4%。
與此同時, 中東供應風險並未消失。沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其與巴基斯坦軍方高層預計討論如何協助沙烏地阿拉伯應對葉門胡塞武裝的攻擊。胡塞武裝持續攻擊沙烏地支持的葉門政府部隊, 並多次向沙烏地阿拉伯境內發射武器, 對這個全球最大石油出口國的能源供應構成威脅。
沙烏地阿拉伯方面表示, 已攔截胡塞武裝向南部塔伊夫省及紅海沿岸延布地區發射的6枚彈道飛彈。市場人士認為, 對沙烏地能源設施與運輸路線的持續威脅, 代表即使美伊外交出現進展, 中東石油供應仍存在新的風險。
另一方面, 荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸量目前尚未出現進一步大幅下滑。航運數據公司Kpler初步資料顯示, 截至9月20日開始的一周, 經由荷姆茲海峽運出的原油達3370萬桶, 大致維持前一周的水準。
沙烏地阿拉伯也持續增加經由東西石油管線輸往紅海出口樞紐延布的原油輸送量。該管線可協助沙烏地繞過荷姆茲海峽, 但業界消息、衛星影像與航運數據顯示, 延布的原油油輪裝載作業尚未全面恢復。
本次中東戰事自2月28日美國與以色列對伊朗發動攻擊後升級, 對全球能源市場造成重大衝擊。戰事爆發後, 全球約五分之一的石油與天然氣運輸受到影響, 原油價格在3月單月一度上漲50%, 同時也迫使液化天然氣買家尋找更遠且更穩定的供應來源。
美國與中國的關係同樣可能影響後續能源需求。美國駐中國大使David Perdue表示, 美國總統川普在與中國國家主席習近平會談時已明確表達, 華府無法接受中國協助伊朗。若美中最終達成降低貿易緊張的協議, 可能有助於全球經濟成長, 並進一步推升能源需求。
除了中東局勢之外, 俄羅斯與烏克蘭戰事也牽動全球能源供應。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基表示, 美國已提議由阿拉伯聯合大公國主辦烏克蘭、俄羅斯三方會議, 討論結束戰爭的努力。俄羅斯總統普丁則表示, 各項和平解決方案仍在桌上, 但莫斯科仍需要評估哪些方案符合俄羅斯利益。
此外, 無人機攻擊造成俄羅斯新沙赫京斯克煉油廠受損, 該煉油廠因此暫時停止運作。俄羅斯煉油設施遭到密集無人機攻擊之際, 聯合國總部也正在討論俄烏之間可能達成與能源相關的停火安排。
若俄烏戰爭最終達成協議, 俄羅斯能源出口可能增加。美國能源資料顯示, 俄羅斯是石油輸出國組織及其盟友(OPEC+)成員, 2025年原油產量排名全球第三, 僅次於美國與沙烏地阿拉伯。
目前油市因此同時受到外交進展、荷姆茲海峽通航狀況、沙烏地能源設施安全、美國柴油出口政策以及俄烏戰事等多重因素影響。短期內, 美伊是否能夠形成具體停戰安排, 以及中東主要產油國能否維持原油出口, 將持續成為油價走勢的重要觀察焦點。
paras_en: International oil prices fell more than 2% on Friday the 25th as markets held higher expectations for diplomatic progress between the United States and Iran to end the fighting, while also being affected by news that the United States may ban diesel exports. However, Yemen’s Houthi forces continued to attack Saudi Arabia, keeping traders on guard for further Middle‑East oil‑supply disruptions.

Brent crude futures fell $2.28, down 2.1%, to $104.32 a barrel on Friday; U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures dropped $2.20, down 2.3%, to $92.41 a barrel. On a weekly basis Brent was up just under 1% while WTI was down about 8%.

Oil markets have been highly volatile recently; on Thursday the two benchmark prices surged about 5%, with Brent closing up 3.4% and WTI up 2.7%. New diplomatic signals from the U.S.–Iran talks prompted the market to reassess the cooling of the conflict’s impact on supply, pushing prices lower on Friday.

Sources close to the negotiations said U.S. and Iranian representatives are in New York working on a phased plan to end the war, which could include Tehran reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Washington lifting its economic blockade on Iran. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world’s most important energy corridors, carrying roughly 20% of global oil supplies before the conflict erupted.

However, Iran has shown no signs of conceding on its nuclear program. A senior Iranian official said that even if the United States accepts Tehran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, Iran will not make any nuclear‑program concessions. Iran’s proposal also calls for the U.S. to lift its maritime blockade of Iranian ports, among other demands.

Energy consultancy Ritterbusch and Associates noted that the market is being pulled in two directions: investors are still weighing the impact of a possible U.S. diesel export ban, while diplomatic progress could allow the Strait of Hormuz to resume shipping, together amplifying price volatility.

The discussion of a U.S. diesel export restriction is also reshaping the price relationship between U.S. and global crude benchmarks. The market worries that if U.S. refiners cannot export diesel, domestic diesel supplies could rise, forcing refiners to cut crude runs and suppressing U.S. crude demand.

As a result, Brent’s premium over WTI widened for the third consecutive trading day to its highest level since May, reflecting differing supply‑demand conditions in the global versus U.S. markets. U.S. gasoline futures also fell about 4% on the same day.

At the same time, Middle‑East supply risks have not disappeared. Senior military officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan are expected to discuss how to help Saudi Arabia counter Houthi attacks. The Houthis continue to strike Saudi‑backed Yemeni government forces and have repeatedly fired weapons into Saudi territory, threatening the world’s largest oil exporter’s energy supply.

Saudi Arabia said it intercepted six ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis toward the southern province of Taif and the Red Sea coastal area of Yanbu. Market participants view the ongoing threat to Saudi energy facilities and transport routes as a sign that, even with diplomatic progress, Middle‑East oil supply still faces new risks.

On the other hand, oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz have not shown a further sharp decline. Preliminary data from shipping data firm Kpler indicate that in the week starting September 20, about 33.7 million barrels of crude were shipped through the strait, roughly level with the previous week.

Saudi Arabia is also continuing to increase crude shipments to the Red Sea export hub of Yanbu via the East‑West pipeline. The pipeline helps Saudi Arabia bypass the Strait of Hormuz, but industry sources, satellite imagery and shipping data show that loading operations at Yanbu’s tankers have not fully resumed yet.

The current Middle‑East conflict escalated after the United States and Israel launched attacks on Iran on February 28, delivering a major shock to global energy markets. Since the outbreak, roughly one‑fifth of worldwide oil and gas shipments have been affected, crude prices surged 50% in March, and liquefied natural‑gas buyers have been forced to seek farther, more stable supplies.

U.S.–China relations could also shape future energy demand. U.S. ambassador to China David Perdue said President Trump made it clear in his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping that Washington cannot accept Chinese assistance to Iran. If the U.S. and China eventually reach an agreement to ease trade tensions, it could boost global economic growth and further lift energy demand.

Beyond the Middle‑East, the Russia‑Ukraine war also influences global energy supply. Ukrainian President Zelensky said the United States has proposed a three‑way conference hosted by the United Arab Emirates involving Ukraine and Russia to discuss ending the war. Russian President Putin said various peace proposals remain on the table, but Moscow still needs to assess which options serve Russian interests.

In addition, a drone attack damaged Russia’s new Sakhalin‑Kishinev refinery, forcing it to halt operations temporarily. While Russian refining assets are under intense drone assault, the United Nations headquarters is also discussing a possible energy‑related ceasefire arrangement between Russia and Ukraine.

If a settlement is eventually reached in the Russia‑Ukraine war, Russian energy exports could rise. U.S. energy data show Russia is an OPEC+ member and is projected to rank third in global crude production in 2025, behind only the United States and Saudi Arabia.

The oil market is therefore being influenced simultaneously by diplomatic developments, the reopening status of the Strait of Hormuz, the security of Saudi energy infrastructure, U.S. diesel export policy and the Russia‑Ukraine conflict. In the short term, whether the U.S. and Iran can forge a concrete cease‑fire plan and whether major Middle‑East producers can maintain crude exports will remain key drivers of oil‑price movements.

items.title: AI基建熱藏後患？大賣空貝瑞警告5巨頭產能過剩 恐面臨資產減損
items.title_en: AI Infrastructure Boom Hides Future Risks? Short‑Seller Burry Warns Five Giants of Overcapacity and Possible Asset Impairments
paras: 《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 週五 (25日)警告，大型科技巨頭競相擴建 AI 基礎設施，投資規模與未來付款義務同步攀升。若新增產能日後超過市場需求，相關企業可能在 2028 年或 2029 年認列資產減記。由於承諾金額龐大，即使減記比例不高，衝擊也可能超出目前預期。
貝瑞在 Substack 文章中指出，截至 6 月 30 日，標普 500 成分企業的淨資本投資相當於美國國內生產毛額 (GDP) 的 2.07%。若排除 2000 年 3 月那斯達克指數見頂後的時期，這是近 40 年來最高水準。
他預期，未來幾季這項比率還會攀升，甚至可能超過當年的高點。
貝瑞估計，微軟 (MSFT-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOG-US)(GOOGL-US)、Meta (META-US) 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US)，與 AI 基礎設施相關的採購承諾、未來租約、擔保、在建工程及其他曝險，合計約 3 兆美元。
這筆估算涵蓋不同性質的項目，並非 5 家企業已支出的資本總額，也不能全部歸為未來付款義務。
貝瑞將目前的 AI 建設潮與 1990 年代末科技、媒體及電信業的擴張相提並論。當年大規模投資後，業界面臨產能過剩、報酬下滑，以及沉重的折舊與資產減損。
他指出，後續影響曾使標普成分股企業的淨投資總額，在 2003 年中至 2006 年中連續 12 季落入負值。他擔心，這波 AI 投資的風險也可能在產能建成後浮現。
貝瑞另以甲骨文為例，質疑其對客戶預付款的會計處理。他指出，合約結構使甲骨文的未來雲端營收增加近 20%，但公司並未立即提供額外服務或交付成果。
其他媒體報導指出，甲骨文的信用違約交換 (CDS) 曾升至歷史高點，公司也向新墨西哥州「木星計畫」資料中心的開發商發出援引不可抗力條款的通知，以因應成本上升。
貝瑞表示，除蘋果 (AAPL-US) 外，全球獲利能力最強的企業正大力押注 AI，但自由現金流轉為負值，借款速度也在加快。他的警告指向同一個問題：未來 AI 需求能否跟上企業持續建置的產能。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the real‑life inspiration for “The Big Short,” warned on Friday (the 25th) that large tech giants are racing to expand AI infrastructure, with investment scales and future payment obligations rising in tandem. If the added capacity later exceeds market demand, the companies could record asset write‑downs in 2028 or 2029. Because the committed amounts are huge, even a modest write‑down could have a bigger impact than currently expected.

In a Substack post, Burry noted that as of June 30, net capital investment by S&P 500 constituents equaled 2.07% of U.S. gross domestic product. Excluding the period after the Nasdaq peaked in March 2000, this is the highest level in nearly four decades.
He expects the ratio to climb further over the next few quarters, potentially surpassing the peak of that year.

Burry estimates that Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOG‑US/GOOGL‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) have combined AI‑related procurement commitments, future leases, guarantees, construction in progress and other exposures of roughly $3 trillion.
That estimate covers projects of different natures; it is not the total capital already spent by the five firms, nor can it be fully classified as future payment obligations.

Burry likens the current AI‑building frenzy to the late‑1990s expansion in technology, media and telecommunications. After massive investments then, the industry faced overcapacity, falling returns, and heavy depreciation and asset impairments.

He points out that the subsequent fallout caused the net investment totals of S&P constituents to be negative for twelve consecutive quarters from mid‑2003 to mid‑2006, and he worries a similar risk could emerge once AI capacity is built out.

Burry also uses Oracle as an example, questioning its accounting for customer pre‑payments. He says the contract structure boosts Oracle’s future cloud revenue by nearly 20%, yet the company does not immediately deliver additional services or deliverables.

Other media reports note that Oracle’s credit‑default swaps once spiked to historic highs, and the firm sent a force‑majeure notice to the developer of New Mexico’s “Jupiter” data‑center project to cope with rising costs.

Burry says that aside from Apple (AAPL‑US), the world’s most profitable companies are heavily betting on AI, but free cash flow has turned negative and borrowing is accelerating. His warning centers on a single issue: whether future AI demand can keep pace with the capacity companies continue to build.

items.title: 川普：與習近平會晤富有成效 將有重大事情發生
items.title_en: Trump: Meeting with Xi Jinping Productive, Major Developments Ahead
paras: 美國總統川普週五 (25 日) Truth Social 發文表示，對兩國來說，他與中國國家主席習近平的會談「富有成效」，並預告接下來將有「有重大事情發生」。
川普接著談到人工智慧 (AI) 的名稱，他表示，習近平似乎和幾乎所有人一樣，喜歡把他認為「命名不佳且不準確」的「人工智慧」，改稱為更準確、也更重要的「超級智慧」(super intelligence)。川普說：「那是『超級』！昨晚所有人也都同意。」
習近平自週三起對美國進行為期 3 天的國是訪問，這是他自 2015 年以來第 2 次訪美。
川普與習近平週四舉行會談，並出席國宴。川普表示，美中兩國關係「從未像現在這麼好」，但也指出兩國「代表不同的制度」。
習近平則表示，兩人進行了「坦誠、深入的交流」，並在多項議題上達成共識；這次討論也為美中關係提供「新的戰略指引」。
在與習近平會談前，川普曾表示，兩位領袖當天就安全、科技與超級智慧等迫切議題作出的決定，「能夠在未來數十年間促進和平與繁榮」。
美國貿易代表葛里爾 (Jamieson Greer) 透露，美方預計下週一 (28 日) 公布美中貿易談判的詳細內容，說明雙方過去數週協商取得的成果。他接受 CNBC 訪問時透露，美中已同意將部分關鍵商品排除在貿易爭端之外。
葛里爾指出，美國將向中國出口農產品與醫療器材，並從中國進口消費品及其他非敏感商品。
美中貿易休戰原定 11 月 10 日屆滿。
美國財長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 週三 (23 日) 在華府與中國國務院副總理何立峰會面後表示，雙方已同意將休戰協議延長 2 個月，至明年 1 月 10 日。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social on Friday (the 25th) that his talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping were "productive" for both countries and hinted that "something big is about to happen."

Trump then turned to the term artificial intelligence (AI), saying Xi, like almost everyone else, prefers to replace what he considers a "poorly named and inaccurate" "artificial intelligence" with the more precise and significant label "super intelligence." Trump added: "That's super! Everyone agreed last night."
Xi began a three‑day state visit to the United States on Wednesday, his second trip to Washington since 2015.

Trump and Xi held a meeting on Thursday and attended a state banquet. Trump said U.S.–China relations have "never been as good as they are now," while also noting that the two nations "represent different systems."
Xi said the two leaders had a "candid, in‑depth exchange" and reached consensus on a number of issues, providing a "new strategic guidance" for U.S.–China relations.
Before the meeting, Trump said the leaders’ decisions on urgent topics such as security, technology and super intelligence "could promote peace and prosperity for decades to come."

U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer disclosed that the United States expects to announce detailed results of the U.S.–China trade talks next Monday (the 28th), outlining the achievements of recent weeks of negotiations. In a CNBC interview he said the two sides have agreed to exclude certain key products from the trade dispute.
Greer noted that the United States will export agricultural products and medical equipment to China, and will import consumer goods and other non‑sensitive items from China.
The U.S.–China trade truce was originally set to expire on November 10.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said after meeting Chinese Vice‑Premier He Lifeng in Washington on Wednesday (the 23rd) that both sides have agreed to extend the truce by two months, until January 10 of next year.

items.title: 川習會後再約兩場！川普預告11月、12 月再會
items.title_en: Trump Schedules Two More Meetings After Xi Visit
paras: 美國總統川普週五 (25 日) 表示，繼中國國家主席習近平結束為期 3 天的訪美行程後，兩人今年還將會面 2 次，分別是 11 月在中國舉行的亞太經濟合作會議 (APEC)，以及 12 月在邁阿密舉行的二十國集團 (G20) 峰會。
習近平週五與川普及第一夫人梅蘭妮亞茶敘時表示，兩人今年還有機會分別在中國和美國見面。
川普當場回應：「我們會的。」
待習近平與夫人彭麗媛離開華府、啟程返中後，川普在 Truth Social 發文確認兩次會面的時間與地點，並形容這次會晤對美中雙方而言，展現了「友誼、力量與成功」。
川普表示，雙方已取得、未來也將取得更多成果，期待下次見面。
至於此次會談談了什麼，川普週五告訴記者，他與習近平討論了伊朗戰爭。美國駐中國大使龐德偉(David Perdue) 也表示，川普已向習近平明確表達，美方無法接受中國協助伊朗。
兩位領袖的討論還涉及人工智慧 (AI) 與農業。
川普暗示，美中可能正在推動一項農業協議，並稱「我認為我們的農民會非常高興，發生了許多非常正面的事」。不過，他在這番談話中沒有說明協議內容。
川普此次鋪設紅毯迎接習近平，接待規格卻在美國國會引發批評。
共和、民主兩黨參議員均對此提出質疑，理由包括中國被指在美國與伊朗的戰爭中協助伊朗，以及北京的人權紀錄。川普過去也曾批評前總統歐巴馬盛大接待習近平。
習近平週五結束第 2 次對美國的國是訪問。他上一次訪美是在 2015 年、歐巴馬執政期間。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 25th) that after Chinese President Xi Jinping wraps up his three‑day visit to the United States, the two leaders will meet twice more this year – at the APEC summit in China in November and at the G20 summit in Miami in December.
During a tea meeting on Friday with Trump and First Lady Melania, Xi said the two of them still have opportunities to meet separately in China and the United States later this year.
Trump replied on the spot, "We will."

After Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan left Washington and headed back to China, Trump posted on Truth Social confirming the dates and locations of the two meetings, describing the encounters as showcasing "friendship, strength and success" for both sides.
Trump said the two sides have already achieved results and will achieve more in the future, and he looks forward to the next meeting.

When asked what was discussed, Trump told reporters on Friday that he and Xi talked about the war in Iran. U.S. ambassador to China David Perdue also said Trump made it clear to Xi that the United States cannot accept Chinese assistance to Iran.
The leaders also discussed artificial intelligence (AI) and agriculture.

Trump hinted that the U.S. and China may be working on an agricultural agreement, saying, "I think our farmers will be very happy; a lot of very positive things have happened," though he did not detail the agreement.
Trump rolled out a red carpet to welcome Xi, but the reception drew criticism in Congress.

Senators from both the Republican and Democratic parties questioned the move, citing China’s alleged assistance to Iran in the U.S.–Iran conflict and Beijing’s human‑rights record. Trump has previously criticized former President Obama’s lavish reception for Xi.
Xi concluded his second state visit to the United States on Friday. His previous visit was in 2015 during the Obama administration.

items.title: 馬斯克放話：Colossus 2部署的輝達晶片年底或增加一倍
items.title_en: Musk Says Colossus 2’s Nvidia Chips Could Double by Year‑End
paras: 馬斯克旗下人工智慧（AI）公司xAI持續擴大AI基礎設施規模。馬斯克當地時間週五（25日）表示，xAI旗下AI算力集群Colossus 2目前已部署55萬顆輝達(NVDA-US) GPU，且年底前晶片數量可能超過目前的2倍。
馬斯克在社群平台X上指出，Colossus 2目前配備11萬顆輝達GB200與44萬顆GB300，合計達55萬顆晶片。
在後續擴充計畫方面，馬斯克表示，首批22萬顆GB300預計下週正式投入運行，另外22萬顆將於11月上線。若進度順利，12月底前還可能再增加22萬顆GB300。
按照目前規劃，Colossus 2今年底前最多可能新增66萬顆GB300，使晶片總數達約121萬顆，較目前55萬顆增加約120%，而新增算力主要將由輝達GB300晶片提供。
此外，馬斯克透露，Colossus 1目前則配備15萬顆H100、5萬顆H200及3萬顆GB200。xAI先前曾表示，計畫到2026年讓位於美國孟菲斯的資料中心配備100萬顆GPU。
此次馬斯克進一步公布Colossus 2的擴充時程，顯示xAI仍持續擴大AI基礎設施規模，未來幾個月將有大量GB300陸續投入運行，使xAI的資料中心算力在今年底前進一步提升，以支撐其AI模型訓練和推理需求。
paras_en: Elon Musk’s AI company xAI is continuing to expand its AI infrastructure. On Friday (the 25th), Musk said that the Colossus 2 AI compute cluster currently has 550,000 Nvidia (NVDA‑US) GPUs deployed, and the chip count could exceed twice that amount by the end of the year.
Musk noted on the social platform X that Colossus 2 is equipped with 110,000 Nvidia GB200 chips and 440,000 GB300 chips, totaling 550,000 units.

Regarding further expansion, Musk said the first batch of 220,000 GB300 chips is slated to go live next week, with another 220,000 to come online in November. If everything proceeds on schedule, an additional 220,000 GB300 chips could be added by the end of December.

Under the current plan, Colossus 2 could add up to 660,000 GB300 chips by year‑end, bringing the total chip count to roughly 1.21 million – about a 120% increase over the existing 550,000 – with the extra compute power coming primarily from Nvidia GB300 chips.

Musk also disclosed that Colossus 1 is presently equipped with 150,000 H100 chips, 50,000 H200 chips and 30,000 GB200 chips. xAI previously announced a plan to outfit its Memphis, Tennessee data center with 1 million GPUs by 2026.

By outlining the expansion timeline for Colossus 2, Musk showed that xAI continues to scale its AI infrastructure, with a large influx of GB300 chips expected over the coming months, further boosting the data‑center compute capacity before year‑end to support its AI model training and inference workloads.

items.title: 台中銀行相挺王冠閎！亞運200公尺蝶式頂尖對決 勇奪金牌續寫歷史新猷
items.title_en: Taichung Bank Backs Crown Hung! Asian Games 200m Butterfly Showdown Yields Gold, Continuing Historic Achievements
paras: 2026年愛知．名古屋亞洲運動會泳池畔再度傳來令全台沸騰的狂喜捷報！由台中銀行長期贊助支持的「台灣蝶王」王冠閎，於今(25)日迎戰其招牌主項「男子200公尺蝶式」決賽。王冠閎再度展現國際頂尖的划手節奏與驚人爆發力，最終以1:55.05力壓群雄、順利完賽，並成功奪下金牌！這不僅再次向國際泳壇證明了台灣體育菁英的世界級實力，也為其運動生涯再添一筆輝煌篇章。作為最有力支持者的台中銀行，在賽後第一時間致上最熱烈的掌聲與祝賀。
200公尺蝶式身為王冠閎的招牌主項，在每一次的比賽中，每一次的躍入水中都是對自我的極限挑戰。面對亞洲運動會的高張力競爭，王冠閎挺住壓力、奮戰到最後一刻的運動家精神，感動了無數守在電視機前的大眾。台中銀行表示，運動員在場上追求卓越的每一秒，背後都是無數汗水與淚水的累積；王冠閎在賽道上展現的堅韌意志力，正是台灣的驕傲。
台中銀行指出，培育國際級運動菁英如同經營優質企業，除需長時間的資源挹注，更仰賴「無論風雨、始終陪伴」的信任。台中銀行早已將「體育社會責任」列為核心ESG指標，並落實「資源扎根基層」與「助攻國際成長」的雙軌策略。不以一時的勝負論英雄，而是成為選手最穩健、最溫暖的後盾，正是台中銀行引領體育永續向上的標竿典範。
隨著亞運高強度賽事的洗禮，王冠閎再度用實力與汗水為台灣泳壇寫下動人故事。台中銀行承諾，未來將持續扮演台灣運動員們最堅不可摧的基石，投入資源扶植多元體育發展，伴隨更多台灣優秀菁英征戰國際舞台，讓世界看見台灣永不放棄的體育硬實力！
paras_en: In the swimming venue of the 2026 Aichi‑Nagoya Asian Games, Taiwan’s “Butterfly King” Crown Hung, long‑time sponsor of Taichung Bank, took on his signature event, the men’s 200‑metre butterfly final, on the 25th. Crown Hung again displayed world‑class rhythm and explosive power, finishing in 1:55.05 to outpace the field and claim the gold medal. This not only re‑affirms Taiwan’s elite status on the international swimming stage but also adds another brilliant chapter to his athletic career. Taichung Bank, his staunchest supporter, offered the loudest applause and congratulations immediately after the race.

The 200‑metre butterfly is Crown Hung’s hallmark event, and each dive into the water tests his personal limits. Facing the high‑pressure competition of the Asian Games, he held his composure and fought to the very end, moving countless viewers watching at home. Taichung Bank noted that every second an athlete strives for excellence is backed by countless drops of sweat and tears; Crown Hung’s resilient will on the racecourse is a source of pride for Taiwan.

Taichung Bank pointed out that nurturing international‑level sports talent is akin to running a quality enterprise: it requires long‑term resource investment and a trust of “standing by through any weather.” The bank has already made “sports social responsibility” a core ESG metric, implementing a dual‑track strategy of “ground‑level resource rooting” and “supporting international growth.” Rather than judging heroes by a single win or loss, it aims to be the most stable and warm‑hearted backing for athletes, setting a benchmark for sustainable sports development.

After the intense Asian Games competition, Crown Hung once again wrote a moving story for Taiwanese swimming with his strength and hard work. Taichung Bank pledges to remain the unshakable foundation for Taiwan’s athletes, investing resources to foster diverse sports development and accompany more outstanding Taiwanese elites onto the international stage, letting the world see Taiwan’s relentless sporting prowess.

items.title: 輸歐鋼品配額管理措施調整 鋼鐵公會：全力配合並協助爭取更多配額
items.title_en: Adjustment of EU Steel Export Quota Management Measures; Steel Association: Fully Cooperating and Assisting in Securing More Quotas
paras: 經濟部敲定金屬塗層鋼板出口歐盟管理措施調整，鋼鐵公會表示，將全力配合落實，一方面協助業者向歐盟爭取更多配額，一方面堅定恪遵法規、公平、公正原則，持續扮演政府與鋼鐵產業間溝通橋樑的角色，共同穩定我國鋼品銷歐秩序。
針對近期外界關切我國金屬塗層鋼板輸歐（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）管理措施中「自由申請配額」之審查程序與分配機制，鋼鐵公會24日出席經濟部邀集產業界召開的研商出口歐盟「4A類鋼品管理措施」事宜會議。
經過5小時的研商會議，產官雙方就配額機制與管理占比所達成的共識與優化方向，包括「自由申請配額」占比調整為10%、核配原則及程序維持現有作法、總額平均分三次申請等，鋼鐵公會表示，將持續全力配合及落實經濟部政策與實務運作管理。
鋼鐵公會也再次聲明，受經濟部國際貿易署委託辦理「輸往歐盟鋼鐵產品簽發放行前原產地證明書及加工證明書業務」，恪遵經濟部與業者討論後的配額管理規定。
鋼鐵公會指出，就「自由申請配額」的審查、計算、分配、登錄階段詳實說明，並再次強調依據經濟部公告「輸歐盟特定463項鋼品配額管理規定」，落實資格、合約要件審查，再依合格總申請量的比例公平計算、分配後確實登錄，秉持公平、公正原則，恪守法遵。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs has finalized adjustments to the management measures for exporting metal‑coated steel sheets to the EU. The Steel Association said it will fully cooperate in implementation, help companies lobby the EU for additional quotas, strictly adhere to regulations and the principles of fairness and justice, and continue to serve as a communication bridge between the government and the steel industry to stabilize Taiwan’s steel exports to Europe.

In response to recent public concerns about the review procedures and allocation mechanism for the “free‑application quota” under the management measures for Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet exports to the EU (Category 4A steel products), the Steel Association attended a meeting convened by the Ministry of Economic Affairs on the 24th to discuss the EU “Category 4A steel product management measures.”

After a five‑hour deliberation, the public and private sides reached consensus and identified optimization directions for the quota mechanism and its share, including adjusting the “free‑application quota” proportion to 10%, keeping the existing approval principles and procedures, and dividing the total quota into three equal application rounds. The Steel Association said it will continue to fully cooperate with and implement the Ministry’s policies and operational management.

The Steel Association also reiterated that, commissioned by the International Trade Department of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, it handles the issuance of pre‑export certificates of origin and processing certificates for steel products shipped to the EU, and will strictly follow the quota management rules discussed with the Ministry and industry players.

The Steel Association explained in detail the review, calculation, allocation, and registration stages for the “free‑application quota,” emphasizing that, in accordance with the Ministry’s announcement of the “Specific 463‑item Steel Product Quota Management Regulations for Export to the EU,” it will enforce eligibility and contract‑requirement checks, then fairly calculate and allocate based on the proportion of qualified total applications, and finally register the results, upholding fairness, justice, and compliance.

items.title: 8月外銷訂單突破千億美元、川習會登場、台股市值衝5.3兆美元登全球第四 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: August Export Orders Surpass $100 Billion, Trump‑Xi Summit Held, Taiwan Stock Market Cap Hits $5.3 T, Ranking Fourth Globally – Weekly Highlights
paras: 經濟部周二(22日)公布8月外銷訂單連19紅，單月達1029.6億美元，首度突破千億美元；川習會周四(24日)登場，科技重量級人物包括黃仁勳、庫克等皆出席；台股總市值於周三(23日)衝上5.3兆美元，躍居全球第四，以下為本週大事回顧：

〈外銷訂單〉連19紅！8月首度飆破千億美元年增71.4% 美國訂單年增近9成 

受惠AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等需求持續極速擴張，經濟部周二(22日)公布8月外銷訂單統計，單月接單金額豪取1029.6億美元，不僅繼7月連18紅後順利寫下「連續19個月正成長」紀錄，更是台灣歷年來「單月接單首度突破千億美元大關」，年增率高達71.4%，大幅刷新歷史新高紀錄，主要來自電子和資訊通信產品年增83.9%到100.5%，並以美國為最大訂單來源，8月接單421.3億美元，年增飆近 9 成。

川習會白宮國宴科技大咖雲集！黃仁勳、庫克、蘇姿丰同桌 中方無企業家出席 

美國總統川普周四(24日)在白宮設國宴款待中國國家主席習近平，華爾街與矽谷重量級人物齊聚，凸顯美國科技與金融界的影響力。相較之下，中國代表團則無中國企業主參與，凸顯雙方對這次峰會的期待可能有落差。

台股總市值5.3兆美元超車印度躍全球第4 神山單日貢獻逾1兆元 

台股周三(23日)開高，雖呈高檔震盪，但在權值股領軍走揚下，終場仍上漲 357.12 點，以 48,157.29 點作收，再度改寫歷史新高紀錄，台灣資本市場的世界排名也出現歷史性突破，最新總市值衝上 5.3 兆美元，首度超越印度，躋身全球第 4 大股票市場。而最大的功臣莫過於護國神山台積電，單日就貢獻了超過新台幣 1 兆元的市值增幅。

〈台泥拓展東歐市場〉擬以272億元企業價值 併購烏克蘭第二大水泥公司 

台泥(1101-TW)周三(23日)召開重大訊息記者會，臨時董事會通過授權集團旗下荷蘭子公司TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V.，以不超過7.5億歐元(約新台幣272億元)的企業價值，收購烏克蘭水泥建材公司Ivano-Frankivskcement(IFCEM)等公司100%股權，進一步將歐洲水泥版圖由南歐、西歐延伸至東歐市場。

〈工資審議〉正式突破3萬大關261萬人受惠！最低工資明年月薪30900元時薪205元 

最低工資審議會周四(24日)結果出爐，經勞、資、學、政四方代表充分討論後，拍板自116年1月1日起，每月最低工資由現行29,500元調升至30,900元，調幅達4.745%；每小時最低工資亦比照同等調幅，由196元調整至205元。全案將由勞動部陳報行政院核定。若經行政院順利核定，這將是自105年以來連續11年調漲最低工資，不僅象徵月薪正式邁入3萬元大關，更預估有高達261.16萬名勞工受惠，持續為基層勞工權益與基本生活保障注入強心針。

陽明：荷姆茲海峽「情況蠻嚴峻」 看Q4淡季僅緩步修正 

貨櫃航商陽明(2609-TW)周二(22日)召開法說會時指出，雖進入第四季海運淡季後貨量會緩步走緩，但荷姆茲海峽通行與管理權仍無共識且「情況蠻嚴峻」，再加上塞港問題使供需結構仍相對穩定，整體來看，淡季僅呈現緩步修正。
paras_en: On Tuesday (the 22nd), the Ministry of Economic Affairs reported that August export orders continued a 19‑month streak of growth, reaching $102.96 billion – the first time monthly orders have broken the $100 billion mark. The Trump‑Xi summit took place on Thursday (the 24th), with tech heavyweights such as Jensen Huang and Tim Cook in attendance. Taiwan’s total stock‑market capitalization rose on Wednesday (the 23rd) to $5.3 trillion, propelling it to the world’s fourth‑largest market. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

Export orders: 19 consecutive months of growth! August’s orders surged past $100 billion, up 71.4% year‑on‑year, with U.S. orders jumping nearly 90%. Driven by booming demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced on Tuesday (the 22nd) that August export orders totaled $102.96 billion. This continued a streak of 19 straight months of growth after July’s 18‑month run and marked the first time a single month’s orders have exceeded $100 billion in Taiwan’s history. The year‑on‑year increase hit 71.4%, a new record, led by electronics and ICT products that grew 83.9% to 100.5%, with the United States remaining the biggest buyer at $42.13 billion – up almost 90% year‑on‑year.

Trump‑Xi summit draws a tech‑heavy White House banquet: Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, and Cher Wang share a table; no Chinese entrepreneurs attend. U.S. President Donald Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping at a White House state dinner on Thursday (the 24th). Prominent figures from Wall Street and Silicon Valley gathered, highlighting the influence of America’s tech and finance sectors. In contrast, the Chinese delegation had no business leaders present, suggesting differing expectations for the summit.

Taiwan stock market cap reaches $5.3 trillion, overtaking India to become the world’s fourth‑largest. The market opened higher on Wednesday (the 23rd) and, despite trading in a high‑range swing, closed up 357.12 points at 48,157.29, setting a new all‑time high. The total market value climbed to $5.3 trillion, surpassing India for the first time and securing the fourth‑largest stock market globally. The biggest contributor was “national guardian” TSMC, which alone added more than NT$1 trillion to market cap in a single day.

Taiwan Cement expands into Eastern Europe, planning a €750 million (≈NT$27.2 billion) acquisition of Ukraine’s second‑largest cement firm. Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) held a major news conference on Wednesday (the 23rd). Its board authorized the Dutch subsidiary TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V. to acquire 100% of Ivano‑Frankivsk Cement (IFCEM) and related assets for up to €750 million (about NT$27.2 billion), extending the company’s European footprint from Southern and Western Europe into the Eastern European market.

Minimum‑wage review breaks the NT$30,000 barrier, benefiting 2.61 million workers. The minimum‑wage council released its decision on Thursday (the 24th) after extensive deliberation among labor, business, academia and government representatives. Effective Jan 1, 2027, the monthly minimum wage will rise from NT$29,500 to NT$30,900 (a 4.745% increase), and the hourly rate will go from NT$196 to NT$205. The Labor Ministry will submit the proposal to the Executive Yuan for approval. If approved, this will be the 11th consecutive annual increase since 2016, pushing monthly wages past the NT$30,000 mark and is expected to benefit roughly 2.6116 million workers.

Yang Ming: Hummus Strait “situation is quite severe,” Q4 off‑season only sees modest correction. During its earnings call on Tuesday (the 22nd), container carrier Yang Ming (2609‑TW) said that although cargo volumes will ease gradually in the fourth‑quarter off‑season, the lack of consensus on navigation and management rights in the Hummus Strait remains “quite severe.” Combined with port‑congestion issues, the supply‑demand balance stays relatively stable, and the off‑season is expected to bring only a modest correction.

items.title: 「搶配額」大戰落幕！經部落槌：輸歐鋼品總額分3次開放、自由配額減半
items.title_en: "Quota Battle" Ends! Ministry of Economic Affairs Strikes: EU Steel Export Quota Split into Three Rounds, Free Quota Halved
paras: 對近期鋼鐵業者高度關注的我國金屬塗層鋼板（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）出口歐盟管理措施，經濟部昨（24）日緊急邀集代表性鋼鐵業者、貿易商及鋼鐵公會等各方代表，展開長達5小時的跨部會與產業深度研商。經濟部今（25）日正式對外宣布，雙方已達成重大共識，決定將「自由申請配額」占比由原本的20%調降至10%，且總額將平均分三次開放申請，有效避免開開放即被一搶而空的亂象，全力維護我國鋼鐵外銷秩序。

因應歐盟關稅防衛 經濟部跨部會共識敲定

經濟部說明，歐盟自2019年起對進口鋼鐵實施關稅配額防衛措施，並給予台灣特定的國家配額。為維持鋼品輸歐秩序，政府與鋼鐵公會及業界共同研擬出配額機制，將國家配額劃分為「出口實績」與「自由申請配額」兩大類。若業界無特別共識，先前預設自由配額占比為20%。
隨著歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施於今（2026）年6月底屆期，歐盟自7月1日起繼續以關稅配額方式管制鋼品輸入，並新增金屬塗層鋼板的國家配額。為協助國內業者穩健拓展歐盟市場，經濟部比照先前機制公告相關規範，並續由鋼鐵公會辦理受理、審查與分配作業。

審查機制透明化 配額改分三次申請避免秒殺

鋼鐵公會於會中強調，針對4A類別的「自由申請配額」，公會始終秉持公平公正原則，嚴格落實資格審查與合約規範，並依據合格總申請量的比例公開計算與登錄分配，確保各家業者權益。
為了解決業者反映「剛開放申請配額就被搶光」的痛點，會中經充分溝通後達成兩項關鍵調整：
配額比例調降： 金屬塗層鋼板的「自由申請配額」占比由20%調降至10%，擴大實績業者的穩定配額。
分階段開放申請： 自由配額總額將採取平均分三次申請的方式發放，防範短時間內配額耗盡。
經濟部強調，政府高度重視鋼鐵業者的出口利益，未來將因應國際經貿情勢變化，持續與業界保持密切溝通，並滾動式檢討各類輸歐鋼品的分配機制，協助台灣鋼鐵產業在國際市場立於不敗之地。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held an emergency five‑hour inter‑agency and industry round‑table yesterday (the 24th) to discuss Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet (Category 4A steel exports to the EU), which has drawn intense attention from the steel sector. The ministry announced today (the 25th) that a major consensus has been reached: the share of “free‑application quota” will be cut from the original 20% to 10%, and the total amount will be released in three equal batches, preventing the chaos of the quota being snapped up instantly and fully safeguarding Taiwan’s steel export order.

The ministry explained that the EU has applied anti‑dumping tariff‑quota safeguards on imported steel since 2019 and granted Taiwan a specific national quota. To maintain orderly steel exports to the EU, the government, together with the steel association and industry, devised a quota mechanism that divides the national quota into “export‑performance quota” and “free‑application quota.” In the absence of a specific industry agreement, the free quota was previously set at 20%.

As the EU’s steel defence measures expire at the end of June 2026, the EU will continue to regulate steel imports via tariff‑quota from July 1 and has added a national quota for metal‑coated steel sheets. To help domestic firms steadily expand into the EU market, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced the relevant rules based on the previous mechanism and will continue to have the Steel Association handle applications, reviews and allocations.

The Steel Association emphasized during the meeting that for the 4A “free‑application quota,” it will always uphold fairness and impartiality, strictly enforce eligibility checks and contract standards, and publicly calculate and record allocations based on the proportion of qualified total applications, ensuring the rights of all firms.
To address industry complaints that “the quota is snatched up as soon as it opens,” the meeting, after thorough discussion, agreed on two key adjustments:
Quota share reduction: the “free‑application quota” for metal‑coated steel sheets will be lowered from 20% to 10%, expanding stable allocations for firms with proven export performance.
Staged application: the total free quota will be distributed in three equal rounds, preventing the quota from being exhausted in a short period.

The ministry stressed that the government places great importance on the export interests of steel companies and will, in response to changing international trade conditions, maintain close communication with the industry and continuously review the allocation mechanisms for all EU‑bound steel products, helping Taiwan’s steel sector remain competitive in the global market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉PCB擺脫鬼故事！台日供應鏈點火 009828周漲逾7%重返發行價
items.title_en: Hot Stock: PCB Breaks the Ghost Story! Taiwan-Japan Supply Chain Ignites, 009828 Gains Over 7% This Week, Returns to Issue Price
paras: 日本股市在結束三天假期後於 24 日恢復交易，吸引資金顯著回補；同時，台股 CCL 族群擺脫先前「降級鬼故事」陰霾，激勵整體 PCB 類股近期連袂上揚。在台日兩地供應鏈齊揚的帶動下，中信台日韓 PCB(009828-TW)展現強勁反彈力道，24 日股價順利站回 10 元發行價，終場上漲 1.73% 收在 10.02 元，單周累計漲幅達 7.28%。整體交投表現持續增溫，反映市場資金關注重心再度強勢回歸。
009828於9月初掛牌，隨即遭遇市場利空，多處於破發狀況，但本周展開強勁反彈，主要歸功於台日兩地 AI 供應鏈的共振效應，日股方面，受惠AI伺服器與高效能運算(HPC)需求，全球IC載板龍頭Ibiden(揖斐電)盤中一度暴漲逾15%，強勢領軍日經指數補漲行情。台股雖呈高檔震盪，但AI硬體升級概念股維持強勁動能，載板與銅箔基板(CCL)族群逆勢上揚，其中聯茂更是亮燈漲停。
法人指出，近期PCB個股逆勢上揚，反映資金正由純AI晶片概念擴散至整體AI硬體供應鏈(如ABF載板、PCB及伺服器設備)。009828聚焦台、日、韓三地的PCB產業鏈龍頭，前十大持股涵蓋欣興、Ibiden、台光電、日東電工、臻鼎-KY、金像電、台燿與南電等關鍵企業。
根據TPCA與工研院產科國際所最新研究，全球載板產值預估於2025年達到147.5億美元(年增18.5%)，2026年更將在AI伺服器、高速交換器與先進封裝需求帶動下，進一步成長至195.1億美元(年增32.3%)，長線成長趨勢明確。
中信台日韓PCB ETF經理人葉松炫表示，過去PCB產業景氣循環較容易受到PC與智慧型手機需求影響，但隨著AI伺服器逐漸成為產業新的成長引擎，市場結構正出現明顯轉變。由於AI伺服器所需PCB層數、材料規格及單機價值均顯著高於傳統伺服器，使產業成長動能不再僅來自出貨量增加，更受惠於產品規格升級所帶來的價值提升。
葉松炫指出，在全球科技巨頭持續擴大AI資料中心投資的帶動下，AI產業發展已從晶片設計與先進製程，進一步延伸至ABF載板、高階PCB及關鍵材料等領域。隨著AI應用持續普及，相關供應鏈可望持續受惠於資料中心建置與硬體升級需求，長線成長潛力值得關注。

paras_en: Japan's stock market resumed trading on the 24th after a three‑day holiday, drawing a notable capital rebound; at the same time, Taiwan's CCL sector shed the previous "downgrade ghost story" gloom, spurring the entire PCB segment to rise together. Driven by a synchronized Taiwan‑Japan supply chain, the China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF (009828‑TW) showed strong rebound power, with its price on the 24th back at the NT$10 issue price, closing up 1.73% at NT$10.02 and up 7.28% for the week. Overall trading activity kept warming, reflecting a renewed strong focus of market funds.

009828 listed in early September and was immediately hit by market headwinds, trading below its issue price in many places, but this week it staged a robust rebound, mainly thanks to the resonant effect of AI supply chains in both Taiwan and Japan. In Japan, AI server and high‑performance computing (HPC) demand lifted global IC substrate leader Ibiden, whose shares surged more than 15% intraday, leading a Nikkei rebound. Taiwan’s market, though trading in a high‑range range‑bound manner, saw AI hardware upgrade concept stocks maintain strong momentum, with substrate and copper‑foil board (CCL) groups climbing against the trend, and Lianmao hitting a limit‑up.

Institutional investors note that recent PCB stocks are rising against the tide, indicating capital is shifting from pure AI chip concepts to the broader AI hardware supply chain (such as ABF substrates, PCBs and server equipment). 009828 focuses on the PCB industry leaders in Taiwan, Japan and Korea, with its top ten holdings covering key firms like Unimicron, Ibiden, Taiwan‑Optoelectronics, Nitto Denko, Zhen Ding‑KY, Golden Image, Taiwan‑Yao and Nan‑Dian.

According to the latest research by TPCA and the Industrial Technology Research Institute’s International Production Center, global substrate output is projected to reach $14.75 billion in 2025 (up 18.5% YoY) and to grow further to $19.51 billion in 2026 (up 32.3% YoY) driven by AI servers, high‑speed switches and advanced packaging demand, underscoring a clear long‑term growth trend.

China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF manager Yeh Song‑hsuan said that the PCB industry's business cycle used to be heavily influenced by PC and smartphone demand, but as AI servers become a new growth engine, the market structure is shifting markedly. Because AI servers require PCBs with more layers, higher‑grade materials and a higher unit value than traditional servers, industry growth now stems not only from volume increases but also from value added by upgraded specifications.

Yeh added that, propelled by global tech giants continuously expanding AI data‑center investments, AI development has moved beyond chip design and advanced processes to include ABF substrates, high‑end PCBs and critical materials. As AI applications keep spreading, the related supply chain is expected to benefit continuously from data‑center builds and hardware upgrades, offering notable long‑term growth potential.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉ABF載板供需缺口續擴大 欣興滾量重返千金周漲20%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: ABF Substrate Supply‑Demand Gap Continues to Widen, Unimicron’s Volume Rises, Returns to Thousand‑Dollar Week Up 20%
paras: AI大量需求推升需求，外資高盛報告指出ABF載板供需缺口擴大之中，明、後年缺口尤甚，刺激載板欣興(3037-TW)重獲買盤本周股價重獲買盤擁抱，本周外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線。
PCB及IC載板廠欣興最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收以177.46億元創新高，月增9.18%，年增56.26%，欣興2026年1-8月營收1143.35億元，年增34.16%。欣興 2026 年上半年 營收爲 625.56 億元，毛利率 21.61%，年增 8.39 個百分點，上半年稅後純益 193.56 億元，年增 18.23 倍，每股純益達 11.7 元。
欣興因 AI 及 HPC 需求強勁，2026 上半年 AI 產品占比已超過 60%，下半年可望提升到 70%，欣興並且樂觀看待下半年營收持續成長。
欣興本周獲外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線，技術線型呈現多頭排列，短線支撐在5日線1093元。
paras_en: AI's massive demand is boosting demand. A foreign‑capital Goldman Sachs report points out that the supply‑demand gap for ABF substrates is widening, with the gap especially large in the next two years, spurring substrate maker Unimicron (3037‑TW) to regain buying interest. This week the stock was embraced by buyers, with foreign investors net buying 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages.

PCB and IC substrate manufacturer Unimicron's latest revenue figures show that revenue in August 2026 reached a record high of NT$17.746 billion, up 9.18% month‑on‑month and 56.26% year‑on‑year. Unimicron's revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$114.335 billion, a 34.16% annual increase. In the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$62.556 billion, gross margin 21.61% (up 8.39 percentage points year‑over‑year). First‑half net profit after tax was NT$19.356 billion, 18.23 times higher year‑over‑year, and earnings per share reached NT$11.7.

Because of strong AI and HPC demand, AI products accounted for more than 60% of Unimicron's sales in the first half of 2026, and are expected to rise to 70% in the second half. Unimicron is also optimistic that revenue will continue to grow in the second half.

This week Unimicron was net bought by foreign investors for 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages. The technical chart shows a bullish arrangement, with short‑term support at the 5‑day line of NT$1,093.

items.title: 伊朗提7天內重啟荷姆茲方案 阿拉奇：選擇權在美方手中
items.title_en: Iran Proposes 7‑Day Restart of Hormuz Plan; Al‑Arabi: Choice Lies with the United States
paras: 美伊在紐約的談判據報已從初步外交接觸，進入較具體的技術討論階段。與此同時，伊朗提出重開荷姆茲海峽的 7 天方案。伊朗外交部長阿拉奇週五 (25 日) 表示，只要必要條件獲得滿足，海峽就能在 7 天內恢復正常通航，目前選擇權在美方手中。
半島電視台報導指出，在美國特使魏科夫與川普女婿庫許納參與初步會談後，技術專家也加入討論。
德黑蘭消息人士稱，談判已進入處理具體問題的階段。伊朗代表團的美國簽證起初尚未獲核准，但隨後迅速取得，使代表團得以參與會談。
同日，伊朗外長阿拉奇在聯合國大會場邊表示，伊朗已透過卡達向美國提出方案。被問及 7 天從何時起算，阿拉奇說，美國一旦接受，時程就會啟動；若美方隔天接受，就從隔天開始計算。
阿拉奇指出，方案要求美國採取若干行動。他認為，美方可在第 4 到第 5 天內完成，而這些要求均已列入雙方先前的諒解備忘錄，因此伊朗認為執行上並不困難。
不過，他在這段說明中並未逐項列出美方須採取的行動。
按照阿拉奇所述的順序，美方先接受方案並履行條件，荷姆茲海峽再於第 6 天開放，第 7 天恢復談判。他表示，如果美國有意達成協議並重開海峽，伊朗方面已做好準備；方案的下一步取決於美方決定。
談及海峽安全，阿拉奇說：「海峽目前的不穩定局勢，是美以兩國侵略行動的直接結果，目前取決於美國如何選擇。伊朗不接受脅迫、威脅或恐嚇，也不會在壓力下放棄主權權利。」
阿拉奇還批評：「你不能轟炸一個國家、威脅將其殲滅，對其實施海上封鎖及脅迫措施，卻還期待航行安全自動恢復。」
美伊局勢降溫之下，西德州原油期貨週五下跌 2.33%，收每桶 92.41 美元；布蘭特原油期貨下跌 2.14%，收每桶 104.32 美元。
paras_en: U.S. and Iranian talks in New York have reportedly moved from initial diplomatic contact to a more concrete technical discussion stage. At the same time, Iran has put forward a 7‑day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian Foreign Minister Al‑Arabi said on Friday (the 25th) that the strait could resume normal navigation within seven days once the necessary conditions are met, and that the option now rests with the United States.
According to Press TV, after U.S. envoy Wicker and former President Trump’s son‑in‑law Kushner participated in preliminary talks, technical experts also joined the discussion.

Sources in Tehran say the negotiations have entered a phase of addressing specific issues. The Iranian delegation’s U.S. visas were not initially approved, but were quickly obtained thereafter, allowing the team to take part in the talks.

On the same day, Foreign Minister Al‑Arabi told reporters on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly that Iran had submitted the proposal to the United States via Qatar. When asked when the seven‑day clock would start, he said it would begin once the U.S. accepts the plan; if the U.S. accepts the next day, the count would start from that day.

Al‑Arabi noted that the plan requires the United States to take several actions. He believes the U.S. could complete them between day 4 and day 5, and that these requirements were already included in the previous memorandum of understanding, so Iran does not see implementation as difficult.
However, he did not list the specific actions the United States must take in his remarks.

According to Al‑Arabi’s sequence, the U.S. first accepts the plan and fulfills the conditions, the Strait of Hormuz would be opened on day 6 and negotiations would resume on day 7. He said that if the United States is willing to reach an agreement and reopen the strait, Iran is ready; the next step of the plan depends on the U.S. decision.

Speaking about the strait’s security, Al‑Arabi said: “The current instability in the strait is a direct result of aggressive actions by the United States and Israel, and it now depends on how the United States chooses. Iran will not accept coercion, threats, or intimidation, nor will it abandon its sovereign rights under pressure.”
Al‑Arabi also criticized: “You cannot bomb a country, threaten its annihilation, impose a naval blockade and coercive measures, and then expect safe navigation to automatically resume.”
With U.S.–Iran tensions easing, West Texas Intermediate crude futures fell 2.33% on Friday, closing at $92.41 per barrel, while Brent crude futures dropped 2.14% to $104.32 per barrel.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉傳美伊進入技術磋商階段 道瓊勁揚近480點 三大指數周線收紅
paras: 市場對美伊局勢降溫、荷姆茲海峽有望重新開放的期待升高，國際油價週五 (25 日) 回落，美股擺脫早盤震盪後全面收高。道瓊終場勁揚近 480 點，標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數均上漲約 0.5%，費半指數漲逾 1%。
本週累計，道瓊上漲 0.3%，標普 500 指數上漲 1.2%，那斯達克指數上漲約 2%。AI 題材帶動大型科技股走強，在油價、美債殖利率及升息預期同步攀升之際，支撐美股守住週線漲幅。
週五市場情緒首先受到油價下滑提振。市場傳出美伊談判進入技術磋商階段，伊朗提出可在7天內重開荷姆茲海峽的方案，伊朗也要求美方恢復落實6月簽署、其後未獲完整執行的諒解備忘錄。投資人將焦點放在雙方可能恢復協商的訊號，暫時淡化尚未取得正式外交突破的事實。
西德州原油期貨週五下跌 2.33%，收每桶 92.41 美元；布蘭特原油期貨下跌 2.14%，收每桶 104.32 美元。
債市賣壓週五仍未消退，10 年期美債殖利率盤中升至 2007 年以來最高水準，30 年期殖利率則觸及 2004 年以來高點，尾盤分別約報 5.163%及 5.488%。
本週債券賣壓主要來自能源價格引發的通膨疑慮、強勁的採購經理人指數 (PMI)，以及 Fed 官員接連釋出鷹派訊號。芝商所 FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預估 Fed 10 月升息 1 碼的機率約為 64%，高於一週前的約 58%。
川習會同樣受到市場關注。中國國家主席習近平結束訪美行程後，美國總統川普預告，兩人今年還將在亞太經濟合作會議 (APEC)，以及 12 月在邁阿密舉行的二十國集團 (G20) 峰會會面。
美國貿易代表葛里爾 (Jamieson Greer) 表示，美方將於下週一 (28 日) 公布更多美中談判細節。美國財長貝森特此前表示，兩國已同意將貿易休戰延長 2 個月。
美股週五 (25 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。微軟 (MSFT-US) 強漲 3.66%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.53%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.46%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 小漲 0.12%；Meta (META-US) 下跌 3.33%。

台股 ADR 多收高。日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.86%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 漲 0.87%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 漲 0.17%；台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 跌 0.12%。
企業新聞
輝達 (NVDA-US) 微漲約 0.2% 至每股 225.07 美元，週漲幅為 0.91%。馬斯克週四表示，預計將為旗下太空探索技術公司 SpaceX 再採購 22 萬顆輝達 AI 晶片。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 走低 1.54% 至每股 372.11 美元，週線變化不大，特斯拉人形機器人 Optimus 的週產量在上月已達數百台，約為今年第 2 季小批量測試階段每週數十台的 10 倍。管理層設定的下一步目標，是在年底前建成可連續運作的自動化產線，使產能超過每週 1,000 台。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 強漲約 3.6% 至每股516.17 美元。該公司為人工智慧 (AI) 助理 Copilot 推出多項新功能。
Meta (META-US) 下滑超 3.3% 至每股 751.66 美元，儘管市場對其 AI 模型 Muse 的關注持續升高。Meta 本週累計漲幅仍超過 10%。
超微 (AMD-US) 小漲約 0.2%，報每股 630.63 美元。美國銀行週五將超微目標價由 620 美元調升至 720 美元。該股本週迄今已大漲 7%，市值首度突破 1 兆美元。
Nike (NKE-US) 收黑 0.67% 至每股 35.75 美元。美國銀行將 Nike 評級由「中立」調降至「表現不佳」，並將目標價由 47 美元大幅下修至 30 美元，認為該公司的轉型策略可能延後至 2028 會計年度才會見到成效。
華爾街分析
The Wealth Alliance 總裁 Eric Diton 指出，隨著美債殖利率攀升，投資人的悲觀情緒較兩週前明顯增加。不過，標普與那指距近期高點僅約 1%，反映美股面對利率衝擊仍展現韌性。他也警告，若殖利率繼續上升，最終可能對股市造成更明顯的壓力。
LPL Financial 跨資產策略長 Adam Turnquist 表示，即使油價一度突破每桶 100 美元、10 年期美債殖利率升破 5%，貨幣政策預期也重新轉向緊縮，標普 500 指數仍維持在歷史高點附近，主要受到大型科技股重掌市場領導地位支撐。
Truist 投資長 Keith Lerner 則認為，利率仍將是短期市場的主要驅動因素。住宅建商、不動產投資信託、零售及公用事業等利率敏感類股已承受壓力，但市場內部經歷價格與估值修正後，短線拉回也可能帶來進場機會。
